name: Major Schwartzkoff
role: U.S. Army major on the mountain
summary: The major Larry names at the center of VN-0006, setting up a rocket launcher on top of the mountain: "Middle is Major Schwartzkoff Right: Australian Captain Left: I think is captain Kennedy from Boston." The camps' radio call signs were his: "Body Jab 42, Right Cross, Upper Cut, Might have been a Body Jab 41, 43, Major Schartkoff was in charge of them." When Larry asked to go out on patrol, the major told him to get a weapon, and sent him back when he came with a pistol: "If you go out there with that pistol you are unarmed…" Larry took a BAR.
researchNotes: The spelling is his son's rendering of the sound; "Schartkoff" is the 2026-09-01 telephone transcription. Identification work and candidate hypotheses are kept in research/people/major-schwartzkoff.md and are not summarized here while unconfirmed. Recollections: giscus-vn-0006-c18006884 and -c18260039, 2026-09-01-phone-boxing-call-signs, giscus-stories-c18119622. 2026-09-15, on his son's decision (no spelling notes on public pages): the rendered aliases were trimmed; removed from display, kept here: "Schwartzkoff (phonetic)"; "Schwarzkopf". "Schwarzkopf" came off with them: it reads as an identification the archive has not made.
